args: Current grasp stage only. Assess ONLY a vertical open-gripper approach centered over the measured package to a pad height 25 mm above its top, without touching it. Confirm empty open fingers and visible free external passages with at least 10 mm separation from other objects. Request depth points p0,p1,p2,p3 on four uniquely identifiable printed material landmarks of the SAME cream cheese top, and s0,s1,s2 on separated bare local TABLE patches, including the finger approach area. Use whichever current camera genuinely sees each landmark. Table points must be noncollinear and distributed, not bowl, robot or stove. Choose and describe an initial quartet spread in TWO world directions, preferably in the half toward the short end with larger world x so it can remain observable near the hand. Aim for spans above 24 mm and 18 mm, not four points along one letter. Use exact printed tips/intersections, not arbitrary unmarked interior pixels or mixed-depth silhouette corners. labels must describe p0 through p3 in order. Report only current visible evidence. passages concerns the two bare descent passages beside the package, not invented hidden wall surfaces. route excludes intended package contact but must include nearby bowl, bottle and table obstacles. If retrying, use the other camera or a genuinely different depth-valid patch for a table point, not the same failed measurement. On initial selection only, a rejected quartet may be replaced as a whole before a reference is established.

result.explanation: The current views show the labeled cream cheese lying flat, with empty, open fingers above it. Both bare side passages are visible. The bowl, bottle and plate are outside the proposed local vertical descent. Visible spacing, together with the supplied package scale and finger dimensions, supports at least 10 mm external separation for the approach ending with pads 25 mm above the top. This does not authorize contact, closure or transport. The lower wrist-image occlusion is the robot itself, not an observed external obstruction. All seven requested points are returned anew. The printed quartet extends beyond the preferred larger-world-x half to obtain approximately 62 mm longitudinal and 19 mm transverse spans. These are image selections for depth sampling, not newly measured metric coordinates. The table samples are noncollinear and include both finger approach areas.

labels: p0: Lower-facing terminal of the right-hand curl of the initial large capital C in Cream.
p1: Upper terminal of the first small white subtitle letter inside the blue badge, to the left of the large lettering.
p2: Right-hand curl terminal of the large capital C starting Cheese, distinct from the capital C in Cream.
p3: Bottom terminal stroke of the final lowercase e in Cheese.
